audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits 53.6% over 2332 games — you edge the early rows, he takes the late one.
Level 6 belonging to Ekko is right: Chronobreak makes his all-in reversible while Chum the Waters is a hard commit. Late row belongs to him as the rewind falls to 50s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup named Chronobreak as the tracked spell but never stated the stun source, and no cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Ekko's stun is Parallel Convergence (W) at 22/20/18/16/14 — the anomaly is visible before it arms. Phase Dive (E) is a 9s dash with an auto-attack reset, and both Playful/Trickster and Chum the Waters ground it. Chronobreak is 110/80/50 and heals off damage taken, so Grievous Wounds matters.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, dosFull[1].d, enemyWin and wants.you[2] now carry the real numbers, the grounding answer and the anti-heal call.

edits.before: W-empowered last hits and short Q trades — your passive ignores minion block, so fish through the wave freely.
edits.after: You edge level 1: W-empowered last hits and short Q trades, with Parallel Convergence still unlearned.

edits.before: Q-W trade pattern live: dash through, bleed, walk out through the wave nobody else can walk through.
edits.after: You keep the edge: Q through him, W bleed, out before Timewinder's grenade rewinds back through you.

edits.before: Late Fizz erases one carry per fight: shark the entry, string the target, pole the response, swim away.
edits.after: Chronobreak drops to 50 seconds late — he undoes the kill you earned and rewinds out of your string.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Playful / Trickster like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Chronobreak (R): 110s at rank 1, 50s at rank 3 — it undoes your kill, so hold your last burst until the rewind has landed. - Parallel Convergence (W) is his only stun, 22s at rank 1, and the anomaly is visible before it arms. - Phase Dive is 9s and grounding kills it.

edits.before: Q through him, W bleed, walk out through the wave — the fish phases in and out before his answer finds a target.
edits.after: Phase Dive is his gap-closer on 9s — Playful/Trickster grounds it, so hop as he warps and he lands with nothing.

edits.before: Hopping in first against a held CC — the pole spent as an entrance is the whole kit spent as a coin flip.
edits.after: The pole is your answer to Parallel Convergence — spend it early and his 22-second anomaly stuns you flat.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Ekko wins by stunning you inside Parallel Convergence, Phase Diving on top, and rewinding the fight away with Chronobreak.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — shark, string, pole, repeat; one carry per fight is the contract and the pole notarizes it.
edits.after: Carry by killing Ekko outside Chronobreak's window — the rewind is 110s at rank 1 and that gap is your whole game.

edits.before: Fish the strings and respect one spell — his CC is the lane; everything else is water.
edits.after: Fish short strings and respect Parallel Convergence — the anomaly is the only stun he owns.

edits.before: Look to burst him down fast in isolated fights before his rewind timer resets
edits.after: Buy Grievous Wounds before 6, since Chronobreak heals off the damage you just dealt him

edits.before: Land Timewinder to slow and set up his all-in combo, since he loses the trade without it
edits.after: Land Timewinder to slow you, then warp in on Phase Dive's empowered attack, since he loses without it

notes: CHART: full phases[].side was 'Skill' on all seven rows against content win[] of Fizz/Fizz/Skill/Skill/Fizz/Fizz/Ekko — five live cross-layer disagreements. content matches packet.levelChart, so I moved the full layer onto it for rows 0, 1 and 6.
